rag_rationale: Pilot results are solid, but wave 2 go-live has slipped five weeks on two external dependencies; agree with Amber.
headline: Pilot cuts handle time 11%, but wave 2 slips to December awaiting the new knowledge index and AI approval.
progress: Copilot used on 55% of eligible pilot tickets (up from 38%)
Hallucination rate in weekly audit down from 4.1% to 2.3% with prompt library v3
Running cost €18 per 1,000 tickets vs €25 budget

risks.title: Copilot scaled on stale knowledge content
risks.description: The product knowledge index from the data platform has slipped; going live on the legacy SharePoint export risks wrong pricing and warranty answers.
risks.mitigation: Hold wave 2 until the product index is live; manual refresh of top 200 articles in the interim.
risks.evidence: Until that lands we would be scaling a copilot that answers from stale content.

risks.title: No Responsible AI approval for go-live
risks.description: The customer-facing GenAI checklist does not exist yet, so formal go-live approval cannot be granted.
risks.mitigation: Escalated to sponsor; CRM-01 offered as test case for the draft checklist.
risks.evidence: No checklist = no approval = no go-live.

risks.title: Partner agents blocked on SSO access
risks.description: Outsourced agents in Tallinn cannot use the copilot until partner SSO and conditional access are in place.
risks.evidence: We also still need SSO / conditional access for the copilot web app before it can be opened to the outsourced partner agents in Tallinn

risks.title: Agent adoption plateau
risks.description: Some experienced agents ignore copilot suggestions, limiting handle-time gains.
risks.mitigation: Champions network and coaching via the Skills Academy.

risks.title: Model token pricing rise in 2027
risks.description: Announced provider pricing changes may make the run-cost assumption about 10% too low.

dependencies.what: Product knowledge index built from the lakehouse product catalogue
SSO / conditional access for partner agents

asks: Confirm wave 2 waits for the new knowledge index rather than going live on legacy content
Press the AI Governance board for a date on the customer-facing GenAI checklist
